headline: Nandan Denim reports no demat requests for Q2 FY27
hook: Zero demat requests for Nandan Denim
summary: Nandan Denim has filed its mandatory SEBI depository compliance certificate for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. The filing confirms that the company received zero requests for dematerialization of shares during this period. This is a routine regulatory disclosure required for listed companies to ensure compliance with depository participant standards.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on share price.
